description: Adds repository-qualified shared task-worktree roots and an explicit Codex permission-profile configurator and preflight.
delta: Task worktree paths now live below a user-selected shared root and are namespaced by repository identity. Codex configuration is planned read-only and applied only explicitly through an atomic, backup-preserving permission-profile update. Both workflows receive the same bounded command policy, and host preflight reports trust, filesystem access, policy activation, and Git metadata independently.
verification: path and collision tests cover remote namespaces, equal task IDs, and deterministic local fallback identities
configuration tests cover check/apply idempotence, comment preservation, backup creation, atomic failure, and conflicting models
both workflow command policies pass the Codex execpolicy decision table
python3 scripts/check_repository.py and python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v pass
